title: Kanyadaan
desc: Rekha and Amar get married in their childhood. But when they grow up, Rekha is surprised to find out that Amar has already married someone else.

title: Sanjog
desc: Asha's life turns upside down when she realizes that her guardians are not her real parents and her real mother is mentally ill.

title: Farz
desc: Inspector Ravi risks his life to uphold justice, confronting dangerous criminals while balancing loyalty, duty and sacrifice.

title: Khel Khilari Ka
desc: A skilled player enters high-stakes conflicts, using intelligence and bravery to overcome rivals and hidden threats.

title: Ek Shriman Ek Shrimati
desc: In a love triangle, Deepali, the wealthy industrialist's daughter, finds herself torn between her feelings for Pritam and her true love, Ajit. Drama and passion ensue!

title: Dulhan Wahi Jo Piya Man Bhaye
desc: When Harikishan suffers a heart-attack, he reluctantly agrees to let his grandson marry Rita, who unknown to him, is a street florist.

title: Ittefaq
desc: A police officer investigates a double murder with two witnesses who are suspects: Vikram, a writer, and Maya, a homemaker-whose accounts clash that night.

title: Shirdi Ke Sai Baba
desc: A doctor has no faith in the powers of Sai Baba. However, his wife and he travel to Shirdi when their son falls sick. After hearing certain stories of Sai Baba, the doctor develops faith in him.

title: Satyam Shivam Sundaram
desc: Rajeev falls for Roopa, a beautiful singer concealing half her disfigured face. After marriage, he discovers her secret and starts to ignore her, leading to emotional turmoil in their relationship.

title: Immaan Dharam
desc: Ahmed, Mohan Are Con Men Posing As False Witnesses. Meeting Kabir, They Want To Reform But Face Challenges. When Kabir Is Jailed For Murder He Didn'T Commit, They Vow To Find The Real Culprit But Land In Trouble Themselves.

title: Muqabla
desc: Two brothers find themselves jobs in the police department, when difference arise between them personally and professionally.

title: Insaaf Kaun Karega
desc: Jageera abandons his wife and son Vikram to join a life of crime. Years later, when Vikram, now a police officer, sets out to put an end to Jageera's activities, he swears to kill him.

title: Shehzada
desc: Bantu, despised by his father Valmiki, discovers his true parents, the Jindals, and strives to win their affection while protecting them from threats.

title: Abhinetri
desc: Shekhar, a young scientist, falls in love with Anjana, a dancer, and marries her. Differences separate the couple but when Shekhar's mother visits, they are forced to unite again.

title: Parivar (1968)
desc: Gopal, a medical student, marries Meena and starts a family. Their peaceful life is disrupted by tragedy as their daughter dies and Gopal is accused of murder.
